name: Impending Flux
oracle_text:
Paradox — Impending Flux deals X damage to each opponent and each creature they control, where X is 1 plus the number of spells you've cast from anywhere other than your hand this turn.
Foretell {1}{R}{R} (During your turn, you may pay {2} and exile this card from your hand face down. Cast it on a later turn for its foretell cost.)
blocked_sentences: Paradox — Impending Flux deals X damage to each opponent and each creature they control, where X is 1 plus the number of spells you've cast from anywhere other than your hand this turn.

needs.what: a value counting the spells a player has cast this turn from a zone other than their hand (Paradox): `spells_cast_this_turn` with a cast-zone filter, e.g. {"player": "you", "not_from_zone": ["hand"]}, which needs the turn ledger's SPELL_CAST fold to record each cast's `cast_from_zone` beside `spells_cast_ids`
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `spells_cast_this_turn` counts either all casts or those whose printed face matches a selector filter (`_matches_printed`); the ledger records only the cast card id, not the zone it was cast from. `GameObject.cast_from_zone` and the `from_zone`/`not_from_zone` keys exist only on spell filters for player statics (`cast_zone_matches`), not on the turn-ledger value. Counting all spells would overcount every hand-cast spell, including Impending Flux itself when cast from hand
